Players step into the boots of an everyday beekeeper recruited for an authentic NASA expedition to Mars, completing interactive training mini-games, crew briefings, and mission challenges powered by real NASA expedition data.

details:
What It Does & How It Works

Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an educational, 2D top-down RPG designed to teach kids how real NASA space missions come together from start to finish. Players step into the boots of an everyday beekeeper who receives an unexpected invitation to join a real-world-inspired NASA expedition to Mars.

Using classic RPG exploration and storytelling, players guide the beekeeper through the full mission lifecycle:

• Pre-Launch Training & Crew Prep: Players explore NASA facilities, speak with mission specialists, and learn how different roles—from engineers to flight directors—work together.

• Hands-On Mission Challenges: Players complete interactive mini-games and puzzles based on actual spaceflight steps, including pre-flight checks, resource management, and planetary navigation.

• Authentic NASA Mission Data: The game integrates real data and timelines from successful NASA Mars expeditions so that every stage, obstacle, and fact mirrors real space exploration.

Benefits & Intended Impact

• Inspiring Everyday Explorers: By making a humble beekeeper the hero of a Mars mission, the game challenges the myth that space is only for rocket scientists. Its core message—if a simple beekeeper can make it to Mars, so can you—empowers kids from all backgrounds to see themselves in STEM and space exploration.

• Connecting the Big Picture: Instead of memorizing isolated facts from a textbook, kids experience how teamwork, patience, and problem-solving connect every stage of a real space mission.

• Active, Joyful Learning: Turning complex aerospace concepts into a playable, story-driven adventure keeps young learners engaged and curious.

Creativity & Design Considerations

• An Unlikely Hero: Choosing a beekeeper as our protagonist was a deliberate creative choice. Beekeeping requires patience, careful observation, and ecosystem management—everyday skills that translate surprisingly well to astronaut training.

• Nostalgic Pixel-Art Charm: Inspired by beloved story-rich RPGs like Undertale, Deltarune, and Stardew Valley, we designed expressive, human-drawn pixel art and witty dialogue to make NASA science feel warm, approachable, and fun.

• Kid-Centered Accessibility: Our team carefully considered reading levels, pacing, and visual clarity so younger players can grasp real NASA concepts without feeling overwhelmed by technical jargon.

Tools, Languages, Hardware & Software Used

• Game Engine & Coding Language: Built in GameMaker Studio using GameMaker Language (GML) for player movement, dialogue trees, mini-game logic, and mission progression.

• Art & Asset Creation: Hand-drawn original character sprites, animations, and tilesets created in ibisPaint (using The Spriters Resource as a formatting reference), paired with Gemini AI assistance for the spacecraft cockpit background.

• Development & Pitch Support: Claude and Manus AI were used for rapid GML prototyping and debugging, while Manus AI also assisted with video generation for our pitch presentation.

• Hardware: Standard Windows laptops for game development and touchscreen devices/styluses for digital pixel-art illustration.
